messages:
maria: Heads up: processor placed a settlement freeze on account RETAIL-309 after three chargebacks on 2026-04-15. Dispute ID D-100412. Need evidence bundle and short timeline.

owen: Got it. Which transactions and timestamps?

maria: Txns 11011, 11012, 11013 — all settled on 2026-04-15 between 02:10 and 05:00 UTC. Chargebacks filed within 8 hours.

finance-bot: Alert: chargeback rate 6% for RETAIL-309 > threshold. Link: /billing/alerts/RETAIL-309/2026-04-15

rita: I'll pull invoices, payout CSV, and webhook retry logs. Any sign of promo stacking?

maria: Two of the transactions used promo code LAUNCH10. Also check if refunds were initiated via dashboard or via API key.

owen: Quick audit shows one refund by merchant-admin user, two refunds by API key sk-live-rtx... which last rotated 2026-01-10. I'll run a last-used-IP query.

ops-bot: Evidence checklist: invoice PDFs, masked PAN on statements, merchant onboarding form, refund timestamps, dashboard audit trail, and webhook payloads. Use evidence_template_v3.pdf.

sam: I pulled IPs: 18.204.33.7 for txns 11011/11013; different cards used. User-agent strings almost identical. That smells like scripted activity.

maria: Good. Prepare S3 upload and send to processor email disputes@payments.vendor with subject 'D-100412 - Redwood evidence'. Also apply a temporary payout hold for 48h. Owen please approve.

owen: Approving payout hold for 48h. Putting account in account_holds.

rita: Evidence ZIP uploaded: s3://redwood-disputes/RETAIL-309/D-100412/evidence_v1.zip. Contents: invoices, audit_snippet.txt (masked), webhook_payloads.json (redacted), onboarding_signed.pdf. Email sent.

sam: Risk flagged related accounts that used LAUNCH10 >5 times in 72h. Found 4 linked accounts sharing signup IP 52.67.120.9. Exported list to S3.

maria: Looping in legal for representment if denied. @sam please keep the timeline tight — processor wants exact UTC timestamps and auth IDs.

sam: Will do. Final note: evidence submitted at 1901234583. Monitor for processor response.
